facts.fact: StackAdapt's Drop Off Funnel refreshes its real-time campaign data at a minimum frequency of every 15 minutes, according to the vendor.
facts.quote: it continually analyzes millions of data points to present real-time data on your campaign at a minimum frequency of 15 minutes.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's Drop Off Funnel lets advertisers compare campaign drop-offs between 2 different dates within the campaign lifetime.
facts.quote: You can also compare between 2 different dates within the campaign lifetime

facts.fact: StackAdapt's Drop Off Funnel shows the reason for bid drop-offs along with the remaining number of bids in a campaign.
facts.quote: The Drop Off Funnel will show the reason for bid drop offs, as well as the remaining number of bids in a campaign.

facts.fact: The StackAdapt blog post on the Drop Off Funnel was published on October 29, 2020.
